description: A class with no template that holds shared logic or state and is created by the injector.
Registers an `@Injectable` in the root injector: one lazily created, tree-shakable instance for the whole app.
Function that returns a dependency from the current injector. Valid only in an injection context (field initializers, constructors, provider factories).
The moment Angular is creating something through DI. `runInInjectionContext(injector, fn)` creates one manually.
Angular 22 shorthand for a root-provided singleton that uses `inject()` only. Options: `autoProvided: false`, `factory`.
Legacy style where dependencies are constructor parameters resolved from TypeScript decorator metadata.
